name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.mem_def
statement: theorem mem_def : i ∈ p ↔ i ∈ p.keys
proof:
:=
  .rfl

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.mem_keys
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_keys : i ∈ p.keys ↔ (p.lookup i).isSome
proof:
:= by
  rw [keys, Finmap.mem_keys, lookup, ← Finmap.lookup_isSome]

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.mem_iff_isSome
statement: theorem mem_iff_isSome : i ∈ p ↔ (p.lookup i).isSome
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_def, mem_keys]

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.lookup_eq_none_iff
statement: theorem lookup_eq_none_iff : p.lookup i = none ↔ i ∉ p
proof:
:= by
  simp [mem_iff_isSome, Option.isSome_iff_ne_none]

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.ext_lookup
statement: theorem ext_lookup (h : ∀ i, p.lookup i = q.lookup i) : p = q
proof:
:=
  FinitePartialFunction.ext (Finmap.ext_lookup h)

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.ext_lookup_iff
statement: theorem ext_lookup_iff : p = q ↔ ∀ i, p.lookup i = q.lookup i
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ ↦ h ▸ rfl, ext_lookup⟩

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.lookup_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem lookup_empty : (∅ : FinitePartialFunction β).lookup i = none
proof:
:=
  Finmap.lookup_empty i

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.lookup_insert_self
statement: @[simp] theorem lookup_insert_self : (p.insert i b).lookup i = some b
proof:
:=
  Finmap.lookup_insert _

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.lookup_insert_of_ne
statement: @[simp] theorem lookup_insert_of_ne (h : j ≠ i) : (p.insert i b).lookup j = p.lookup j
proof:
:=
  Finmap.lookup_insert_of_ne _ h

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.keys_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem keys_empty : (∅ : FinitePartialFunction β).keys = ∅
proof:
:=
  Finmap.keys_empty

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.keys_insert
statement: @[simp] theorem keys_insert : (p.insert i b).keys = Insert.insert i p.keys
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hne
  · simp
  · simp [mem_keys, lookup_insert_of_ne hne, hne]

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.le_def
statement: theorem le_def : q ≤ p ↔ ∀ ⦃i⦄ ⦃b : β i⦄, p.lookup i = some b → q.lookup i = some b
proof:
:=
  .rfl

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.le_of_lookup
statement: theorem le_of_lookup (h : ∀ ⦃i⦄ ⦃b : β i⦄, p.lookup i = some b → q.lookup i = some b) : q ≤ p

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.mem_mono
statement: theorem mem_mono (h : q ≤ p) (hi : i ∈ p) : i ∈ q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.1 (mem_iff_isSome.1 hi)
  exact mem_iff_isSome.2 (by rw [h hb]; rfl)

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.keys_mono
statement: theorem keys_mono (h : q ≤ p) : p.keys ⊆ q.keys
proof:
:=
  fun _ hi ↦ mem_def.1 (mem_mono h (mem_def.2 hi))

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.top_eq_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem top_eq_empty : (⊤ : FinitePartialFunction β) = ∅
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.lookup_top
statement: @[simp] theorem lookup_top : (⊤ : FinitePartialFunction β).lookup i = none
proof:
:=
  lookup_empty

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.insert_le_iff
statement: theorem insert_le_iff : p.insert i b ≤ p ↔ p.lookup i = none ∨ p.lookup i = some b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases hp : p.lookup i with
    | none => exact Or.inl rfl
    | some b' =>
      have h1 := h hp
      rw [lookup_insert_self] at h1
      exact Or.inr h1.symm
  · intro h j c hj
    rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hne
    · rcases h with h | h
      · rw [h] at hj
        simp at hj
      · rw [lookup_insert_self]
        exact h.symm.trans hj
    · rwa [lookup_insert_of_ne hne]

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.insert_le_of_notMem
statement: theorem insert_le_of_notMem (h : i ∉ p) : p.insert i b ≤ p
proof:
:=
  insert_le_iff.2 (Or.inl (lookup_eq_none_iff.2 h))

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.insert_eq_self
statement: @[simp] theorem insert_eq_self (h : p.lookup i = some b) : p.insert i b = p
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_lookup fun j ↦ ?_
  rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hne
  · rw [lookup_insert_self, h]
  · rw [lookup_insert_of_ne hne]

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.insert_le_of_lookup_eq
statement: theorem insert_le_of_lookup_eq (h : p.lookup i = some b) : p.insert i b ≤ p
proof:
:=
  insert_le_iff.2 (Or.inr h)

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.exists_lookup_eq_none
statement:
theorem exists_lookup_eq_none [Infinite ι] (p : FinitePartialFunction β) :
    ∃ i, p.lookup i = none
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Infinite.exists_notMem_finset p.keys
  exact ⟨i, lookup_eq_none_iff.2 fun h ↦ hi (mem_def.1 h)⟩

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.Agree.symm
statement: theorem Agree.symm (h : Agree p q) : Agree q p
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ hp hq ↦ (h hq hp).symm

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.keys_union
statement: @[simp] theorem keys_union : (p.union q).keys = p.keys ∪ q.keys
proof:
:=
  Finmap.keys_union

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.lookup_union_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem lookup_union_eq_some_iff :
    (p.union q).lookup i = some b ↔ p.lookup i = some b ∨ (i ∉ p ∧ q.lookup i = some b)
proof:
:=
  Finmap.mem_lookup_union

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.union_le_left
statement: theorem union_le_left (p q : FinitePartialFunction β) : p.union q ≤ p
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h ↦ lookup_union_eq_some_iff.2 (Or.inl h)

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.union_le_right
statement: theorem union_le_right (h : Agree p q) : p.union q ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  intro i b hb
  by_cases hi : i ∈ p
  · obtain ⟨b'', hb''⟩ := Finmap.mem_iff.1 hi
    rw [h (show p.lookup i = some b'' from hb'') hb] at hb''
    exact lookup_union_eq_some_iff.2 (Or.inl hb'')
  · exact lookup_union_eq_some_iff.2 (Or.inr ⟨hi, hb⟩)

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.compatible_iff_agree
statement: theorem compatible_iff_agree : Compatible p q ↔ Agree p q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hrp, hrq⟩ i b b' hp hq
    exact Option.some.inj ((hrp hp).symm.trans (hrq hq))
  · exact fun h ↦ ⟨p.union q, union_le_left p q, union_le_right h⟩

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.Agree.compatible
statement: theorem Agree.compatible (h : Agree p q) : Compatible p q
proof:
:=
  compatible_iff_agree.2 h

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.unionGraph_of_mem
statement: theorem unionGraph_of_mem (hp : p ∈ G) (h : p.lookup i = some b) : UnionGraph G i b
proof:
:=
  ⟨p, hp, h⟩

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.unionGraph_unique
statement: theorem unionGraph_unique (h : UnionGraph G i b) (h' : UnionGraph G i b') : b = b'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpG, hp⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨q, hqG, hq⟩ := h'
  obtain ⟨r, -, hrp, hrq⟩ := exists_mem_le_le hpG hqG
  exact Option.some.inj ((hrp hp).symm.trans (hrq hq))

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.unionFun_eq_some_iff
statement: theorem unionFun_eq_some_iff : unionFun G i = some b ↔ UnionGraph G i b
proof:
:= by
  letI := Classical.dec (∃ b, UnionGraph G i b)
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases hex : ∃ b, UnionGraph G i b
    · rw [unionFun, dif_pos hex] at h
      exact Option.some.inj h ▸ hex.choose_spec
    · rw [unionFun, dif_neg hex] at h
      simp at h
  · intro h
    have hex : ∃ b, UnionGraph G i b := ⟨b, h⟩
    rw [unionFun, dif_pos hex]
    exact congrArg some (unionGraph_unique hex.choose_spec h)

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.unionFun_principal_top
statement:
@[simp] theorem unionFun_principal_top (i : ι) :
    unionFun (PFilter.principal (⊤ : FinitePartialFunction β)) i = none
proof:
:= by
  cases hu : unionFun (PFilter.principal (⊤ : FinitePartialFunction β)) i with
  | none => rfl
  | some b =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpi⟩ := unionFun_eq_some_iff.1 hu
    have htop : (⊤ : FinitePartialFunction β).lookup i = some b :=
      le_def.1 (PFilter.mem_principal.1 hp) hpi
    rw [lookup_top] at htop
    simp at htop

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.isSome_unionFun_iff
statement: theorem isSome_unionFun_iff : (unionFun G i).isSome ↔ ∃ b, UnionGraph G i b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.1 h
    exact ⟨b, unionFun_eq_some_iff.1 hb⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    rw [unionFun_eq_some_iff.2 hb]
    rfl

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.mem_ofPartialFunction_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_ofPartialFunction_iff {c : ∀ i, Option (β i)} :
    p ∈ ofPartialFunction c ↔ ∀ ⦃i⦄ ⦃b : β i⦄, p.lookup i = some b → c i = some b
proof:
:=
  .rfl

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.insert_empty_mem_ofPartialFunction
statement:
theorem insert_empty_mem_ofPartialFunction {c : ∀ i, Option (β i)} (h : c i = some b) :
    (∅ : FinitePartialFunction β).insert i b ∈ ofPartialFunction c
proof:
:=
  mem_ofPartialFunction_iff.2 <| by
    intro j b' hb'
    rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hne
    · rw [lookup_insert_self] at hb'
      exact h.trans hb'
    · rw [lookup_insert_of_ne hne, lookup_empty] at hb'
      simp at hb'

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.unionFun_ofPartialFunction
statement:
@[simp] theorem unionFun_ofPartialFunction (c : ∀ i, Option (β i)) :
    unionFun (ofPartialFunction c) = c
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  cases hc : c i with
  | some b =>
    exact unionFun_eq_some_iff.2
      ⟨_, insert_empty_mem_ofPartialFunction hc, lookup_insert_self⟩
  | none =>
    cases hu : unionFun (ofPartialFunction c) i with
    | none => rfl
    | some b =>
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hpi⟩ := unionFun_eq_some_iff.1 hu
      have hb := mem_ofPartialFunction_iff.1 hp hpi
      rw [hc] at hb
      simp at hb

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.exists_mem_le_of_forall_unionGraph
proof:
:= by
  suffices h' : ∀ s : Finset ι, ∃ r ∈ G, ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ ⦃b : β i⦄, q.lookup i = some b →
      r.lookup i = some b by
    obtain ⟨r, hrG, hr⟩ := h' q.keys
    exact ⟨r, hrG, fun i b hb ↦ hr i (mem_keys.2 (by rw [hb]; rfl)) hb⟩
  intro s
  refine Finset.induction_on s ?_ ?_
  · obtain ⟨r, hrG⟩ := G.nonempty
    exact ⟨r, hrG, fun i hi ↦ absurd hi (Finset.notMem_empty i)⟩
  · rintro j t - ⟨r, hrG, hrt⟩
    cases hq : q.lookup j with
    | none =>
      refine ⟨r, hrG, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
      intro b hb
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hi with rfl | hit
      · rw [hq] at hb
        simp at hb
      · exact hrt i hit hb
    | some bj =>
      obtain ⟨pj, hpjG, hpj⟩ := h hq
      obtain ⟨r', hr'G, hr'r, hr'p⟩ := exists_mem_le_le hrG hpjG
      refine ⟨r', hr'G, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
      intro b hb
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hi with rfl | hit
      · rw [hq] at hb
        exact Option.some.inj hb ▸ hr'p hpj
      · exact hr'r (hrt i hit hb)

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.ofPartialFunction_unionFun
statement: @[simp] theorem ofPartialFunction_unionFun : ofPartialFunction (unionFun G) = G
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    obtain ⟨r, hrG, hrq⟩ :=
      exists_mem_le_of_forall_unionGraph fun i b hb ↦
        unionFun_eq_some_iff.1 (mem_ofPartialFunction_iff.1 hq hb)
    exact PFilter.mem_of_le hrq hrG
  · intro hqG
    exact mem_ofPartialFunction_iff.2 fun i b hb ↦
      unionFun_eq_some_iff.2 (unionGraph_of_mem hqG hb)

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.ofPartialFunction_lookup
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofPartialFunction_lookup (p : FinitePartialFunction β) :
    ofPartialFunction p.lookup = PFilter.principal p
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ PFilter.mem_principal.2 (le_of_lookup (mem_ofPartialFunction_iff.1 h)),
    fun h ↦ mem_ofPartialFunction_iff.2 (le_def.1 (PFilter.mem_principal.1 h))⟩

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.unionFun_principal
statement:
@[simp] theorem unionFun_principal (p : FinitePartialFunction β) :
    unionFun (PFilter.principal p) = p.lookup
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ofPartialFunction_lookup, unionFun_ofPartialFunction]

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.mem_ofFunction_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_ofFunction_iff {c : ∀ i, β i} :
    p ∈ ofFunction c ↔ ∀ ⦃i⦄ ⦃b : β i⦄, p.lookup i = some b → c i = b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i b hb
    exact Option.some.inj (mem_ofPartialFunction_iff.1 h hb)
  · intro h
    exact mem_ofPartialFunction_iff.2 fun i b hb ↦ congrArg some (h hb)

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.insert_empty_mem_ofFunction
statement:
theorem insert_empty_mem_ofFunction (c : ∀ i, β i) (i : ι) :
    (∅ : FinitePartialFunction β).insert i (c i) ∈ ofFunction c
proof:
:=
  insert_empty_mem_ofPartialFunction rfl

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.unionGraph_ofFunction
statement: theorem unionGraph_ofFunction {c : ∀ i, β i} : UnionGraph (ofFunction c) i b ↔ c i = b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, hqi⟩
    exact mem_ofFunction_iff.1 hq hqi
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨_, insert_empty_mem_ofFunction c i, lookup_insert_self⟩

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.unionFun_ofFunction
statement: @[simp] theorem unionFun_ofFunction {c : ∀ i, β i} : unionFun (ofFunction c) i = some (c i)
proof:
:=
  unionFun_eq_some_iff.2 (unionGraph_ofFunction.2 rfl)

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.unionFun_totalUnion
statement:
@[simp] theorem unionFun_totalUnion (h : ∀ i, (unionFun G i).isSome) (i : ι) :
    unionFun G i = some (totalUnion G h i)
proof:
:=
  (Option.some_get (h i)).symm

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.eq_ofFunction
statement: theorem eq_ofFunction {c : ∀ i, β i} (hc : ∀ i, UnionGraph G i (c i)) : G = ofFunction c
proof:
:= by
  have h : unionFun G = fun i ↦ some (c i) := funext fun i ↦ unionFun_eq_some_iff.2 (hc i)
  have hG := ofPartialFunction_unionFun (G := G)
  rw [h] at hG
  exact hG.symm

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.eq_ofFunction_of_unionFun
statement:
theorem eq_ofFunction_of_unionFun {c : ∀ i, β i} (hc : ∀ i, unionFun G i = some (c i)) :
    G = ofFunction c
proof:
:=
  eq_ofFunction fun i ↦ unionFun_eq_some_iff.1 (hc i)

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.eq_ofFunction_totalUnion
statement:
theorem eq_ofFunction_totalUnion (h : ∀ i, (unionFun G i).isSome) :
    G = ofFunction (totalUnion G h)
proof:
:=
  eq_ofFunction_of_unionFun (unionFun_totalUnion h)

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.mem_coordReq_support
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_coordReq_support : p ∈ (coordReq i (β := β)).support ↔ i ∈ p
proof:
:=
  .rfl

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.meets_coordReq_iff
statement: theorem meets_coordReq_iff : Meets G (coordReq i (β := β)).support ↔ ∃ b, UnionGraph G i b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hqG, hq⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.1 (mem_iff_isSome.1 hq)
    exact ⟨b, unionGraph_of_mem hqG hb⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, q, hqG, hq⟩
    exact ⟨q, hqG, mem_iff_isSome.2 (by rw [hq]; rfl)⟩

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.meets_coordReq_iff_isSome_unionFun
statement:
theorem meets_coordReq_iff_isSome_unionFun :
    Meets G (coordReq i (β := β)).support ↔ (unionFun G i).isSome
proof:
:=
  meets_coordReq_iff.trans isSome_unionFun_iff.symm

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.exists_unionGraph_of_meets
statement:
theorem exists_unionGraph_of_meets (h : Meets G (coordReq i (β := β)).support) :
    ∃ b, UnionGraph G i b
proof:
:=
  meets_coordReq_iff.1 h

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.isSome_unionFun
statement:
theorem isSome_unionFun (h : ∀ i, Meets G (coordReq i (β := β)).support) (i : ι) :
    (unionFun G i).isSome
proof:
:=
  isSome_unionFun_iff.2 (exists_unionGraph_of_meets (h i))

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.forall_meets_coordReq_iff_isSome_unionFun
statement:
theorem forall_meets_coordReq_iff_isSome_unionFun :
    (∀ i, Meets G (coordReq i (β := β)).support) ↔ ∀ i, (unionFun G i).isSome
proof:
:=
  forall_congr' fun _ ↦ meets_coordReq_iff_isSome_unionFun

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.exists_pfilter_total
statement:
theorem exists_pfilter_total [Countable ι] (p : FinitePartialFunction β) :
    ∃ G : PFilter (FinitePartialFunction β), p ∈ G ∧ ∀ i, (unionFun G i).isSome
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hpG, hG⟩ :=
    exists_pfilter_genericFor p (fun i ↦ (coordReq i (β := β)).support)
      fun i ↦ (coordReq i (β := β)).isDense_support
  exact ⟨G, hpG, fun i ↦ isSome_unionFun hG i⟩

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.meets_coordReq_ofFunction
statement:
theorem meets_coordReq_ofFunction (c : ∀ i, β i) (i : ι) :
    Meets (ofFunction c) (coordReq i (β := β)).support
proof:
:=
  ⟨(∅ : FinitePartialFunction β).insert i (c i), insert_empty_mem_ofFunction c i,
    show i ∈ (∅ : FinitePartialFunction β).insert i (c i) from
      mem_iff_isSome.2 (by rw [lookup_insert_self]; rfl)⟩

name: Forcing.FinitePartialFunction.exists_mem_keys_subset
statement:
theorem exists_mem_keys_subset (h : ∀ i, Meets G (coordReq i (β := β)).support) (s : Finset ι) :
    ∃ r ∈ G, s ⊆ r.keys
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.induction_on s ?_ ?_
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := G.nonempty
    exact ⟨r, hr, Finset.empty_subset _⟩
  · rintro j t - ⟨r, hrG, hrt⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hqG, hq⟩ := h j
    obtain ⟨s', hs'G, hs'r, hs'q⟩ := exists_mem_le_le hrG hqG
    refine ⟨s', hs'G, fun k hk ↦ ?_⟩
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hk with rfl | hkt
    · exact mem_def.1 (mem_mono hs'q hq)
    · exact keys_mono hs'r (hrt hkt)

name: Forcing.exists_pfilter_genericFor
statement:
theorem exists_pfilter_genericFor (p : P) {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] (𝒟 : ι → Set P)
    (h : ∀ i, IsDense (𝒟 i)) : ∃ G : PFilter P, p ∈ G ∧ ∀ i, Meets G (𝒟 i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨enc⟩ := nonempty_encodable ι
  letI := enc
  exact ⟨pfilterOfDense p h, self_mem_pfilterOfDense h,
    fun i ↦ meets_iff_exists.2 (exists_mem_pfilterOfDense h i)⟩

name: Forcing.exists_pfilter_genericFor'
statement:
theorem exists_pfilter_genericFor' (p : P) {𝒟 : Set (Set P)} (h𝒟 : 𝒟.Countable)
    (h : ∀ D ∈ 𝒟, IsDense D) : ∃ G : PFilter P, p ∈ G ∧ GenericFor 𝒟 G
proof:
:= by
  haveI := h𝒟.to_subtype
  obtain ⟨G, hpG, hG⟩ := exists_pfilter_genericFor p (fun D : 𝒟 ↦ (D : Set P)) fun D ↦ h D D.2
  exact ⟨G, hpG, fun D hD ↦ hG ⟨D, hD⟩⟩

name: Forcing.isForcingAntichain_iff_pairwise_incompatible
statement:
theorem isForcingAntichain_iff_pairwise_incompatible :
    IsForcingAntichain A ↔ A.Pairwise Incompatible
proof:
:=
  .rfl

name: Forcing.isForcingAntichain_insert
statement:
theorem isForcingAntichain_insert (hA : IsForcingAntichain A)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ A, Incompatible p a) : IsForcingAntichain (insert p A)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  rcases ha with rfl | ha
  · rcases hb with rfl | hb
    · exact absurd rfl hab
    · exact h b hb
  · rcases hb with rfl | hb
    · exact fun hc ↦ h a ha hc.symm
    · exact hA ha hb hab

name: Forcing.isMaximalAntichain_iff
statement: theorem isMaximalAntichain_iff : IsMaximalAntichain A ↔ IsForcingAntichain A ∧ IsPredense A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hA, hmax⟩
    refine ⟨hA, fun p ↦ ?_⟩
    by_contra hp
    push Not at hp
    have hpA : p ∉ A := fun hpA ↦ hp p hpA (.refl p)
    have heq := hmax (isForcingAntichain_insert hA hp) (Set.subset_insert p A)
    exact hpA (heq.symm ▸ Set.mem_insert p A)
  · rintro ⟨hA, hpre⟩
    refine ⟨hA, fun t ht hAt ↦ hAt.antisymm fun b hb ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨a, haA, hba⟩ := hpre b
    by_cases hab : b = a
    · exact hab ▸ haA
    · exact absurd hba (ht hb (hAt haA) hab)

name: Forcing.IsForcingAntichain.exists_isMaximalAntichain
statement:
theorem IsForcingAntichain.exists_isMaximalAntichain (hA : IsForcingAntichain A) :
    ∃ B, A ⊆ B ∧ IsMaximalAntichain B
proof:
:= by
  have H : ∀ c ⊆ {C : Set P | IsForcingAntichain C}, IsChain (· ⊆ ·) c → c.Nonempty →
      ∃ ub ∈ {C : Set P | IsForcingAntichain C}, ∀ s ∈ c, s ⊆ ub := by
    rintro c hcS hchain -
    refine ⟨⋃₀ c, ?_, fun s hs ↦ Set.subset_sUnion_of_mem hs⟩
    rintro a ⟨s, hs, has⟩ b ⟨t, ht, hbt⟩ hab
    rcases hchain.total hs ht with hst | hts
    · exact hcS ht (hst has) hbt hab
    · exact hcS hs has (hts hbt) hab
  obtain ⟨B, hAB, hBmax⟩ := zorn_subset_nonempty _ H A hA
  exact ⟨B, hAB, hBmax.1, fun t ht hBt ↦ hBt.antisymm (hBmax.2 ht hBt)⟩

name: Forcing.IsDense.exists_isMaximalAntichain_subset
statement:
theorem IsDense.exists_isMaximalAntichain_subset (hD : IsDense D) :
    ∃ A ⊆ D, IsMaximalAntichain A
proof:
:= by
  have H : ∀ c ⊆ {C : Set P | IsForcingAntichain C ∧ C ⊆ D}, IsChain (· ⊆ ·) c → c.Nonempty →
      ∃ ub ∈ {C : Set P | IsForcingAntichain C ∧ C ⊆ D}, ∀ s ∈ c, s ⊆ ub := by
    rintro c hcS hchain -
    refine ⟨⋃₀ c, ⟨?_, Set.sUnion_subset fun s hs ↦ (hcS hs).2⟩,
      fun s hs ↦ Set.subset_sUnion_of_mem hs⟩
    rintro a ⟨s, hs, has⟩ b ⟨t, ht, hbt⟩ hab
    rcases hchain.total hs ht with hst | hts
    · exact (hcS ht).1 (hst has) hbt hab
    · exact (hcS hs).1 has (hts hbt) hab
  obtain ⟨A, -, hAmax⟩ := zorn_subset_nonempty _ H ∅
    ⟨Set.pairwise_empty _, Set.empty_subset D⟩
  refine ⟨A, hAmax.1.2, isMaximalAntichain_iff.2 ⟨hAmax.1.1, fun p ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hqD, hqp⟩ := hD p
  by_cases hq : ∃ a ∈ A, Compatible q a
  · obtain ⟨a, haA, r, hrq, hra⟩ := hq
    exact ⟨a, haA, r, hrq.trans hqp, hra⟩
  · push Not at hq
    have hqA : q ∉ A := fun h ↦ hq q h (.refl q)
    have hgrow : insert q A ⊆ A := hAmax.2
      ⟨isForcingAntichain_insert hAmax.1.1 hq, Set.insert_subset hqD hAmax.1.2⟩
      (Set.subset_insert q A)
    exact absurd (hgrow (Set.mem_insert q A)) hqA

name: Forcing.meets_lowerClosure

  · rintro ⟨g, hgG, hgLC⟩

name: Forcing.Meets.exists_mem_le

theorem Meets.exists_mem_le (h : Meets G D) (hD : IsLowerSet D) (hp : p ∈ G) :

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgG, hgD⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨r, hrG, hrg, hrp⟩ := exists_mem_le_le hgG hp
  exact ⟨r, hrG, hD hrg hgD, hrp⟩

name: Forcing.meets_principal

  · rintro ⟨q, hqx, hqD⟩
    exact ⟨q, hqD, PFilter.mem_principal.1 hqx⟩
  · rintro ⟨q, hqD, hxq⟩

theorem genericFor_principal_bot [OrderBot P] (h : ∀ D ∈ 𝒟, IsDense D) :

proof:
:= by
  intro D hD
  obtain ⟨q, hqD, -⟩ := h D hD ⊥

name: Forcing.mem_localizeBelow_of_mem
statement: theorem mem_localizeBelow_of_mem (h : q ∈ D) : q ∈ localizeBelow D p
proof:
:=
  Or.inl (subset_lowerClosure h)

name: Forcing.isDenseOpen_localizeBelow
statement:
theorem isDenseOpen_localizeBelow (h : IsDenseBelow D p) :
    IsDenseOpen (localizeBelow D p)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro r
    by_cases hrp : Compatible r p
    · obtain ⟨s, hsr, hsp⟩ := hrp
      obtain ⟨d, hdD, hds⟩ := h (Set.mem_Iic.2 hsp)
      exact ⟨d, Or.inl (subset_lowerClosure hdD), hds.trans hsr⟩
    · exact ⟨r, Or.inr hrp, le_rfl⟩
  · refine IsLowerSet.union (lowerClosure D).lower fun a b hba ha hb ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨s, hsb, hsp⟩ := hb
    exact ha ⟨s, hsb.trans hba, hsp⟩

name: Forcing.meets_localizeBelow_iff
statement:
theorem meets_localizeBelow_iff (hp : p ∈ G) :
    Meets G (localizeBelow D p) ↔ Meets G D
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hqG, hq | hq⟩
    · exact meets_lowerClosure.1 ⟨q, hqG, hq⟩
    · obtain ⟨s, hsG, hsq, hsp⟩ := exists_mem_le_le hqG hp
      exact absurd ⟨s, hsq, hsp⟩ hq
  · exact fun h ↦ h.mono fun q hq ↦ mem_localizeBelow_of_mem hq

  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := e.exists_apply_le q'
  exact ⟨x, ⟨q', hq'D, hx⟩, e.le_iff_le.1 (hx.trans hq')⟩

  constructor
  · rintro h E ⟨D', hD', rfl⟩
    exact e.meets_mapPFilter_iff.1 (h D' hD')
  · intro h D' hD'
    exact e.meets_mapPFilter_iff.2 (h _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hD'))

name: Forcing.DenseOrderEmbedding.isPFilter_preimage
proof:
:= by
  refine Order.IsPFilter.of_def ?_ ?_ ?_
  · obtain ⟨q', hq'⟩ := H.nonempty
    obtain ⟨p, hpH, -⟩ := hloc q' hq'
    exact ⟨p, hpH⟩
  · rintro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂
    obtain ⟨r, hrH, hr₁, hr₂⟩ := exists_mem_le_le hp₁ hp₂
    obtain ⟨s, hsH, hsr⟩ := hloc r hrH
    exact ⟨s, hsH, e.le_iff_le.1 (hsr.trans hr₁), e.le_iff_le.1 (hsr.trans hr₂)⟩
  · exact fun hxy hx ↦ Order.PFilter.mem_of_le (e.monotone hxy) hx

name: Forcing.SepLE.of_le
statement: theorem SepLE.of_le (h : p ≤ q) : SepLE p q
proof:
:=
  fun _ hr ↦ .of_le (hr.trans h)

name: Forcing.SepLE.trans
statement: theorem SepLE.trans (h1 : SepLE p q) (h2 : SepLE q r) : SepLE p r
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨t, hts, htq⟩ := h1 s hs
  obtain ⟨u, hut, hur⟩ := h2 t htq
  exact ⟨u, hut.trans hts, hur⟩

name: Forcing.SepLE.compatible
statement: theorem SepLE.compatible (h : SepLE p q) : Compatible p q
proof:
:=
  h p le_rfl

name: Forcing.Compatible.of_sepLE_of_sepLE
statement: theorem Compatible.of_sepLE_of_sepLE (h1 : SepLE r p) (h2 : SepLE r q) : Compatible p q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, htr, htp⟩ := h1 r le_rfl
  obtain ⟨u, hut, huq⟩ := h2 t htr
  exact ⟨u, hut.trans htp, huq⟩

name: Forcing.sepEquiv_equivalence
statement:
theorem sepEquiv_equivalence : Equivalence (@SepEquiv P _) where
  refl p
proof:
:= ⟨.refl p, .refl p⟩
  symm h := ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
  trans h1 h2 := ⟨h1.1.trans h2.1, h2.2.trans h1.2⟩

name: Forcing.ofSepMod_toSepMod
statement: @[simp] theorem ofSepMod_toSepMod (p : P) : ofSepMod (toSepMod p) = p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Forcing.toSepMod_ofSepMod
statement: @[simp] theorem toSepMod_ofSepMod (p : SepMod P) : toSepMod (ofSepMod p) = p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Forcing.toSepMod_le_toSepMod
statement: @[simp] theorem toSepMod_le_toSepMod : toSepMod p ≤ toSepMod q ↔ SepLE p q
proof:
:=
  .rfl

name: Forcing.sepQuotient_surjective
statement: theorem sepQuotient_surjective : Function.Surjective (sepQuotient : P → SepQuotient P)
proof:
:=
  fun x ↦ Quotient.inductionOn' x fun p ↦ ⟨ofSepMod p, rfl⟩

name: Forcing.sepQuotient_le_sepQuotient
statement: @[simp] theorem sepQuotient_le_sepQuotient : sepQuotient p ≤ sepQuotient q ↔ SepLE p q
proof:
:=
  toAntisymmetrization_le_toAntisymmetrization_iff

name: Forcing.sepQuotient_monotone
statement: theorem sepQuotient_monotone : Monotone (sepQuotient : P → SepQuotient P)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h ↦ sepQuotient_le_sepQuotient.2 (.of_le h)

name: Forcing.sepQuotient_eq_sepQuotient
statement: @[simp] theorem sepQuotient_eq_sepQuotient : sepQuotient p = sepQuotient q ↔ SepEquiv p q
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_antisymm_iff, sepQuotient_le_sepQuotient, sepQuotient_le_sepQuotient]
  exact .rfl

name: Forcing.compatible_sepQuotient_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem compatible_sepQuotient_iff :
    Compatible (sepQuotient p) (sepQuotient q) ↔ Compatible p q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := sepQuotient_surjective x
    exact .of_sepLE_of_sepLE (sepQuotient_le_sepQuotient.1 hx1)
      (sepQuotient_le_sepQuotient.1 hx2)
  · rintro ⟨r, h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨sepQuotient r, sepQuotient_monotone h1, sepQuotient_monotone h2⟩

name: Forcing.isSeparative_sepQuotient
statement: theorem isSeparative_sepQuotient : IsSeparative (SepQuotient P)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := sepQuotient_surjective x
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := sepQuotient_surjective y
  rw [sepQuotient_le_sepQuotient]
  intro r hrp
  exact compatible_sepQuotient_iff.1
    (hxy _ (sepQuotient_le_sepQuotient.2 (.of_le hrp)))

name: Forcing.IsDense.image_sepQuotient
statement:
theorem IsDense.image_sepQuotient (hD : IsDense D) :
    IsDense (sepQuotient '' D : Set (SepQuotient P))
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := sepQuotient_surjective x
  obtain ⟨q, hqD, hqp⟩ := hD p
  exact ⟨sepQuotient q, ⟨q, hqD, rfl⟩, sepQuotient_monotone hqp⟩

name: Forcing.IsDenseOpen.preimage_sepQuotient
statement:
theorem IsDenseOpen.preimage_sepQuotient {D' : Set (SepQuotient P)} (h : IsDenseOpen D') :
    IsDenseOpen (sepQuotient ⁻¹' D')
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro p
    obtain ⟨y, hyD, hyp⟩ := h.1 (sepQuotient p)
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := sepQuotient_surjective y
    obtain ⟨r, hrq, hrp⟩ := (sepQuotient_le_sepQuotient.1 hyp).compatible
    exact ⟨r, h.2 (sepQuotient_monotone hrq) hyD, hrp⟩
  · exact fun a b hba ha ↦ h.2 (sepQuotient_monotone hba) ha

name: Forcing.mem_sepQuotientPFilter
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_sepQuotientPFilter {G : Order.PFilter P} {y : SepQuotient P} :
    y ∈ sepQuotientPFilter G ↔ ∃ p ∈ G, sepQuotient p ≤ y
proof:
:=
  .rfl

name: Forcing.meets_sepQuotientPFilter_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨p, hpG, hpy⟩, hyD⟩
    exact ⟨p, hpG, hD' hpy hyD⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hpG, hpD⟩
    exact ⟨sepQuotient p, ⟨p, hpG, le_rfl⟩, hpD⟩

name: Forcing.genericFor_sepQuotientPFilter
proof:
:= by
  intro D' hD'
  obtain ⟨p, hpG, hpD⟩ := h _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hD')
  exact ⟨sepQuotient p, ⟨p, hpG, le_rfl⟩, hpD⟩

name: Forcing.genericFor_sepQuotientPFilter_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro h E ⟨D', hD', rfl⟩
    exact (meets_sepQuotientPFilter_iff (h𝒟' D' hD')).1 (h D' hD')
  · exact genericFor_sepQuotientPFilter

name: Forcing.isDenseOpen_compl_pfilter
statement:
theorem isDenseOpen_compl_pfilter (h : IsAtomless P) (G : PFilter P) :
    IsDenseOpen ((G : Set P)ᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro p
    by_cases hp : p ∈ G
    · obtain ⟨q, r, hqp, hrp, hqr⟩ := h p
      by_cases hq : q ∈ G
      · refine ⟨r, fun hr ↦ ?_, hrp⟩
        obtain ⟨s, hsG, hsq, hsr⟩ := exists_mem_le_le hq hr
        exact hqr ⟨s, hsq, hsr⟩
      · exact ⟨q, hq, hqp⟩
    · exact ⟨p, hp, le_rfl⟩
  · exact fun p q hqp hp hq ↦ hp (G.mem_of_le hqp hq)

name: Forcing.not_genericOver_of_visible_compl
statement:
theorem not_genericOver_of_visible_compl (h : IsAtomless P) {M : VisibilityContext P}
    (hvis : M.Visible ((G : Set P)ᶜ)) : ¬GenericOver M G
proof:
:= by
  intro hG
  obtain ⟨p, hpG, hpc⟩ := hG _ ⟨hvis, isDenseOpen_compl_pfilter h G⟩
  exact hpc hpG

name: Forcing.IsCentered.isLinked
statement: theorem IsCentered.isLinked (h : IsCentered A) : IsLinked A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro p hp q hq
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h {p, q} ⟨p, by simp⟩ (by
    intro x hx
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hx with rfl | hx
    · exact hp
    · exact Finset.mem_singleton.1 hx ▸ hq)
  exact ⟨r, hr p (by simp), hr q (by simp)⟩

name: Forcing.IsSigmaCentered.isSigmaLinked
statement: theorem IsSigmaCentered.isSigmaLinked (h : IsSigmaCentered P) : IsSigmaLinked P
proof:
:=
  h.imp fun _ ⟨hc, hcov⟩ ↦ ⟨fun n ↦ (hc n).isLinked, hcov⟩

name: Forcing.isCentered_singleton
statement: theorem isCentered_singleton (p : P) : IsCentered ({p} : Set P)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hsub ↦ ⟨p, fun _ hq ↦ le_of_eq (hsub hq).symm⟩

name: Forcing.isCentered_empty
statement: theorem isCentered_empty : IsCentered (∅ : Set P)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hs hsub ↦ absurd (hsub hs.choose_spec) (Set.notMem_empty _)

name: Forcing.isSigmaCentered_of_countable
statement: theorem isSigmaCentered_of_countable [Countable P] : IsSigmaCentered P
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty P with
  | inl h => exact ⟨fun _ ↦ ∅, fun _ ↦ isCentered_empty, fun p ↦ (h.false p).elim⟩
  | inr h =>
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_surjective_nat P
    exact ⟨fun n ↦ {f n}, fun n ↦ isCentered_singleton (f n),
      fun p ↦ (hf p).imp fun _ hn ↦ hn.symm⟩

:=

name: Forcing.Cohen.CohenMaterialPresentation.mem_designatedReals_derivedContext

name: Forcing.Cohen.mem_diagReq_support
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_diagReq_support {p : Cond} :
    p ∈ (diagReq x).support ↔ ∃ n b, p.lookup n = some b ∧ b ≠ x n
proof:
:=
  .rfl

name: Forcing.Cohen.exists_ne_of_meets_diagReq
statement:
theorem exists_ne_of_meets_diagReq (h : Meets G (diagReq x).support) :
    ∃ n b, genericFun G n = some b ∧ b ≠ x n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hqG, n, b, hb, hne⟩ := h
  exact ⟨n, b, unionFun_eq_some_iff.2 (unionGraph_of_mem hqG hb), hne⟩

name: Forcing.Cohen.exists_pfilter_total_diagonalizing
statement:
theorem exists_pfilter_total_diagonalizing {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] (x : ι → ℕ → Bool)
    (p : Cond) :
    ∃ G : PFilter Cond, p ∈ G ∧ (∀ n, (genericFun G n).isSome) ∧
      ∀ i, ∃ n b, genericFun G n = some b ∧ b ≠ x i n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hpG, hG⟩ :=
    exists_pfilter_genericFor p
      (Sum.elim (fun n : ℕ ↦ (coordReq n).support) fun i : ι ↦ (diagReq (x i)).support)
      (Sum.rec (fun n ↦ (coordReq n).isDense_support) fun i ↦ (diagReq (x i)).isDense_support)
  exact ⟨G, hpG, fun n ↦ isSome_genericFun (fun m ↦ hG (.inl m)) n,
    fun i ↦ exists_ne_of_meets_diagReq (hG (.inr i))⟩

name: Forcing.Cohen.parityReal_even
statement:
@[simp] theorem parityReal_even (x : ℕ → ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ) :
    parityReal x (2 * n) = !x n (2 * n)
proof:
:= by
  have h : 2 * n % 2 = 0 := by omega
  have h' : 2 * n / 2 = n := by omega
  simp [parityReal, h, h']

name: Forcing.Cohen.parityReal_odd
statement: @[simp] theorem parityReal_odd (x : ℕ → ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ) : parityReal x (2 * n + 1) = false
proof:
:= by
  have h : (2 * n + 1) % 2 ≠ 0 := by omega
  simp [parityReal]

name: Forcing.Cohen.isLowerSet_oddTrue
statement: theorem isLowerSet_oddTrue : IsLowerSet oddTrue
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hba ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ ⟨n, hba hn⟩

name: Forcing.Cohen.isDense_oddTrue
statement: theorem isDense_oddTrue : IsDense oddTrue
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  set n := p.keys.sup id + 1 with hn
  have hfresh : 2 * n + 1 ∉ p := by
    intro hmem
    have hle : 2 * n + 1 ≤ p.keys.sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) (mem_def.1 hmem)
    omega
  exact ⟨p.insert (2 * n + 1) true, ⟨n, lookup_insert_self⟩,
    insert_le_of_notMem hfresh⟩

name: Forcing.Cohen.support_oddTrueReq
statement: @[simp] theorem support_oddTrueReq : oddTrueReq.support = oddTrue
proof:
:=

name: Forcing.Cohen.isDenseOpen_oddTrue

:=
  oddTrueReq.isDenseOpen_support

name: Forcing.Cohen.parity_separation
statement:
theorem parity_separation (x : ℕ → ℕ → Bool) :
    (∀ n, Meets (ofFunction (parityReal x)) (coordReq n).support) ∧
      (∀ i, Meets (ofFunction (parityReal x)) (diagReq (x i)).support) ∧
      ¬Meets (ofFunction (parityReal x)) oddTrue
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨meets_coordReq_ofFunction _, fun i ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨(∅ : Cond).insert (2 * i) (parityReal x (2 * i)),
      insert_empty_mem_ofFunction _ (2 * i), 2 * i, parityReal x (2 * i), lookup_insert_self, ?_⟩
    rw [parityReal_even]
    cases x i (2 * i) <;> simp
  · rintro ⟨q, hqG, n, hq⟩
    have := mem_ofFunction_iff.1 hqG hq
    rw [parityReal_odd] at this
    exact Bool.noConfusion this

name: Forcing.Cohen.parity_separation_total_diagonalizing
statement:
theorem parity_separation_total_diagonalizing (x : ℕ → ℕ → Bool) :
    (∀ n, (genericFun (ofFunction (parityReal x)) n).isSome) ∧
      (∀ i, ∃ n b, genericFun (ofFunction (parityReal x)) n = some b ∧ b ≠ x i n) ∧
      ¬Meets (ofFunction (parityReal x)) oddTrue
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun n ↦ isSome_genericFun (meets_coordReq_ofFunction _) n,
    fun i ↦ exists_ne_of_meets_diagReq ((parity_separation x).2.1 i),
    (parity_separation x).2.2⟩

name: Forcing.Cohen.totality_separation
statement:
theorem totality_separation (x : ℕ → Bool) :
    (∀ n, Meets (ofFunction x) (coordReq n).support) ∧
      ¬Meets (ofFunction x) (diagReq x).support
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨meets_coordReq_ofFunction x, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨q, hqG, n, b, hb, hne⟩
  exact hne (mem_ofFunction_iff.1 hqG hb).symm

name: Forcing.Cohen.pair_mem_realCode_iff
statement:
theorem pair_mem_realCode_iff {c : ℕ → Bool} {n : ℕ} {b : Bool} :
    ZFSet.pair (natCode n) (boolCode b) ∈ realCode c ↔ c n = b
proof:
:=
  pair_mem_graphCode_iff.trans (by simp)

name: Forcing.Cohen.realCode_injective
statement: theorem realCode_injective : Function.Injective realCode
proof:

name: Forcing.Cohen.lookup_singleCond_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem lookup_singleCond_self {n : ℕ} {b : Bool} :
    (singleCond n b).lookup n = some b
proof:
:=

name: Forcing.Cohen.lookup_singleCond_of_ne
statement:
theorem lookup_singleCond_of_ne {m n : ℕ} {b : Bool} (h : m ≠ n) :
    (singleCond n b).lookup m = none
proof:
:= by
  rw [singleCond, lookup_insert_of_ne h, lookup_empty]

name: Forcing.Cohen.singleCond_mem_iff
statement:
theorem singleCond_mem_iff {G : PFilter Cond} {n : ℕ} {b : Bool} :
    singleCond n b ∈ G ↔ genericFun G n = some b
proof:
:= by
  rw [genericFun_eq_some_iff]
  constructor
  · exact fun h ↦ ⟨singleCond n b, h, lookup_singleCond_self⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, hpn⟩
    refine G.mem_of_le (le_def.2 fun i b' hi ↦ ?_) hp
    rcases eq_or_ne i n with rfl | hne
    · rw [lookup_singleCond_self] at hi
      rwa [← Option.some.inj hi]
    · rw [lookup_singleCond_of_ne hne] at hi
      exact absurd hi (by simp)

name: Forcing.Cohen.zval_cohenRealName
statement:
theorem zval_cohenRealName (G : PFilter Cond) :
    zval (G : Set Cond) cohenRealName = graphCode (genericFun G)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [mem_zval_iff, mem_graphCode_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨n, b⟩, hmem, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨n, b, singleCond_mem_iff.1 hmem, ?_⟩
    rw [show (cohenRealName.elems (⟨n, b⟩ : ℕ × Bool)) =
        check (pairRepr (PSet.ofNat n) (PSet.ofNat (cond b 1 0))) from rfl,
      zval_check G.top_mem, mk_pairRepr]
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨n, b, hnb, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(⟨n, b⟩ : ℕ × Bool), singleCond_mem_iff.2 hnb, ?_⟩
    rw [show (cohenRealName.elems (⟨n, b⟩ : ℕ × Bool)) =
        check (pairRepr (PSet.ofNat n) (PSet.ofNat (cond b 1 0))) from rfl,
      zval_check G.top_mem, mk_pairRepr]
    rfl

name: Forcing.Cohen.zval_cohenRealName_totalUnion
proof:
:= by
  rw [zval_cohenRealName, realCode]
  congr 1
  funext n
  exact unionFun_totalUnion h n

name: Forcing.Cohen.mk_pairRepr
statement:
theorem mk_pairRepr (x y : PSet.{0}) :
    ZFSet.mk (pairRepr x y) = ZFSet.pair (ZFSet.mk x) (ZFSet.mk y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Forcing.Cohen.mem_mk_mk_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_mk_mk_iff {σ : Type} {f : σ → PSet.{0}} {y : ZFSet.{0}} :
    y ∈ ZFSet.mk (PSet.mk σ f) ↔ ∃ i, y = ZFSet.mk (f i)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h z =>
    exact ⟨fun ⟨i, h⟩ ↦ ⟨i, ZFSet.sound h⟩, fun ⟨i, h⟩ ↦ ⟨i, ZFSet.exact h⟩⟩

name: Forcing.Cohen.mem_graphCode_iff
statement:
theorem mem_graphCode_iff {f : ℕ → Option Bool} {y : ZFSet.{0}} :
    y ∈ graphCode f ↔
      ∃ n b, f n = some b ∧ y = ZFSet.pair (natCode n) (boolCode b)
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_mk_mk_iff.trans ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨i.1, (f i.1).get i.2, (Option.some_get _).symm, mk_pairRepr _ _⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, b, hb, rfl⟩
    have hn : (f n).isSome := by rw [hb]; rfl
    refine ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [mk_pairRepr]
    have hg : (f n).get hn = b := Option.some.inj ((Option.some_get _).trans hb)
    rw [hg]
    rfl

name: Forcing.Cohen.pair_mem_graphCode_iff
statement:
theorem pair_mem_graphCode_iff {f : ℕ → Option Bool} {n : ℕ} {b : Bool} :
    ZFSet.pair (natCode n) (boolCode b) ∈ graphCode f ↔ f n = some b
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_graphCode_iff.trans ⟨?_, fun h ↦ ⟨n, b, h, rfl⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨m, c, hc, he⟩
  obtain ⟨hn, hb⟩ := ZFSet.pair_inj.1 he
  rwa [natCode.injective hn, boolCode.injective hb]

name: Forcing.Cohen.graphCode_injective
statement: theorem graphCode_injective : Function.Injective graphCode
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  funext n
  refine Option.ext fun b ↦ ?_
  rw [← pair_mem_graphCode_iff (f := f), ← pair_mem_graphCode_iff (f := g), h]

name: Forcing.Cohen.mk_repr_eq_graphCode
statement:

name: Forcing.Cohen.HasCohenRealName.realCode_totalUnion_mem

name: Forcing.Cohen.exists_realCode_mem_not_mem
statement:
theorem exists_realCode_mem_not_mem (C : CohenMaterialPresentation M)
    (hreal : HasCohenRealName N) {G : PFilter Cond}
    (hG : C.derivedContext.GenericOver G) :
    ∃ htotal : ∀ n, (genericFun G n).isSome,
      realCode (totalUnion G htotal) ∈ N.extensionCarrier (G : Set Cond) ∧
        realCode (totalUnion G htotal) ∉ M
proof:
:= by
  have htotal := isSome_genericFun_of_genericOver C.sees_derivedContext hG
  exact ⟨htotal, hreal.realCode_totalUnion_mem htotal,
    C.not_mem_designatedReals_iff.1
      (not_mem_designatedReals_of_genericOver C.sees_derivedContext hG
        (unionFun_totalUnion htotal))⟩

name: Forcing.Cohen.addsNewReal
statement:
theorem addsNewReal (C : CohenMaterialPresentation M)
    (hcan : HasCanonicalNames C.forcing N) (hreal : HasCohenRealName N)
    (hM : (M : Set ZFSet.{0}).Countable) (p : Cond) :
    ∃ G : PFilter Cond, p ∈ G ∧ C.derivedContext.GenericOver G ∧
      (∀ x ∈ M, x ∈ N.extensionCarrier (G : Set Cond)) ∧
      ∃ htotal : ∀ n, (genericFun G n).isSome,
        realCode (totalUnion G htotal) ∈ N.extensionCarrier (G : Set Cond) ∧
          realCode (totalUnion G htotal) ∉ M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hpG, hG⟩ :=
    exists_pfilter_genericOver p (C.countable_visibleDenseOpen_derivedContext hM)
  exact ⟨G, hpG, hG, fun _ hx ↦ hcan.mem_extensionCarrier_of_mem_pfilter hx G,
    exists_realCode_mem_not_mem C hreal hG⟩

name: Forcing.Cohen.not_mem_designatedReals_of_genericOver
statement:
theorem not_mem_designatedReals_of_genericOver (hM : M.Sees) (hG : M.GenericOver G)
    {c : ℕ → Bool} (hc : ∀ n, genericFun G n = some (c n)) :
    c ∉ M.designatedReals
proof:
:= by
  intro hcM
  obtain ⟨n, b, hb, hne⟩ := exists_ne_of_meets_diagReq (hM.meets_diagReq hG hcM)

name: Forcing.Cohen.exists_avoidingReal_of_genericOver
statement:

proof:
:= by
  have htotal : ∀ n, (genericFun G n).isSome := isSome_genericFun_of_genericOver hM hG
  exact ⟨totalUnion G htotal, unionFun_totalUnion htotal,
    not_mem_designatedReals_of_genericOver hM hG (unionFun_totalUnion htotal)⟩

    ∃ G : PFilter Cond, p ∈ G ∧ M.GenericOver G ∧
      ∃ c : ℕ → Bool, (∀ n, genericFun G n = some (c n)) ∧ c ∉ M.designatedReals
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hpG, hG⟩ := exists_pfilter_genericOver p hcount
  exact ⟨G, hpG, hG, exists_avoidingReal_of_genericOver hM hG⟩

name: Forcing.Cohen.parityReal_not_mem_designatedReals
statement:
theorem parityReal_not_mem_designatedReals (hx : M.designatedReals ⊆ Set.range x) :
    parityReal x ∉ M.designatedReals
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx hmem
  have h2i : x i (2 * i) = parityReal x (2 * i) := congrFun hi (2 * i)
  rw [parityReal_even] at h2i
  cases x i (2 * i) <;> simp at h2i

      parityReal x ∉ M.designatedReals ∧
      ¬M.GenericOver (ofFunction (parityReal x))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun n ↦ isSome_genericFun (meets_coordReq_ofFunction _) n,
    parityReal_not_mem_designatedReals hx, not_genericOver_parityReal hodd⟩

name: Forcing.rank_ofNat
statement: theorem rank_ofNat : ∀ n : ℕ, (PSet.ofNat.{u} n).rank = n
proof:
| 0 => PSet.rank_empty
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [PSet.ofNat, PSet.rank_insert, rank_ofNat n, max_eq_left (Order.le_succ _),
      Nat.cast_succ, Order.succ_eq_add_one]

name: Forcing.natCode_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem natCode_zero : natCode.{u} 0 = ∅
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Forcing.natCode_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem natCode_succ (n : ℕ) :
    natCode.{u} (n + 1) = insert (natCode.{u} n) (natCode.{u} n)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Forcing.node_inj
statement:
@[simp] theorem node_inj {tag k n tag' k' n' : ℕ} {p p' : ZFSet.{u}} :
    node tag k n p = node tag' k' n' p' ↔ tag = tag' ∧ k = k' ∧ n = n' ∧ p = p'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [node, ZFSet.pair_inj, and_assoc]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ ↦ ⟨natCode.injective h1, natCode.injective h2,
      natCode.injective h3, h4⟩,
    fun ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ ↦ ⟨congrArg _ h1, congrArg _ h2, congrArg _ h3, h4⟩⟩

name: Forcing.termCode_free
statement:
@[simp] theorem termCode_free {k n : ℕ} (i : Fin k) :
    termCode (n := n) (.var (Sum.inl i)) = node 0 k n (natCode i)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Forcing.termCode_bound
statement:
@[simp] theorem termCode_bound {k n : ℕ} (j : Fin n) :
    termCode (k := k) (.var (Sum.inr j)) = node 1 k n (natCode j)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Forcing.termCode_inj
statement:
theorem termCode_inj {k n : ℕ} {s t : memLang.Term (Fin k ⊕ Fin n)}
    (h : termCode s = termCode t) : s = t
proof:
:= by
  match s, t with
  | .var (Sum.inl i), .var (Sum.inl i') =>
    simp only [termCode_free, node_inj] at h
    exact congrArg _ (congrArg _ (Fin.val_injective (natCode.injective h.2.2.2)))
  | .var (Sum.inr j), .var (Sum.inr j') =>
    simp only [termCode_bound, node_inj] at h
    exact congrArg _ (congrArg _ (Fin.val_injective (natCode.injective h.2.2.2)))
  | .var (Sum.inl _), .var (Sum.inr _) => simp at h
  | .var (Sum.inr _), .var (Sum.inl _) => simp at h
  | .func f _, _ => exact f.elim
  | _, .func f _ => exact f.elim

name: Forcing.formulaCode_falsum
statement:
@[simp] theorem formulaCode_falsum {k n : ℕ} :
    formulaCode (.falsum : memLang.BoundedFormula (Fin k) n) = node 2 k n ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [formulaCode]

name: Forcing.formulaCode_equal
statement:
@[simp] theorem formulaCode_equal {k n : ℕ} (t₁ t₂ : memLang.Term (Fin k ⊕ Fin n)) :
    formulaCode (.equal t₁ t₂) = node 3 k n (ZFSet.pair (termCode t₁) (termCode t₂))
proof:
:= by
  rw [formulaCode]

name: Forcing.formulaCode_rel
statement:
@[simp] theorem formulaCode_rel {k n : ℕ} (ts : Fin 2 → memLang.Term (Fin k ⊕ Fin n)) :
    formulaCode (.rel memRel.mem ts) =
      node 4 k n (ZFSet.pair (termCode (ts 0)) (termCode (ts 1)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [formulaCode]

name: Forcing.formulaCode_imp
statement:
@[simp] theorem formulaCode_imp {k n : ℕ} (φ ψ : memLang.BoundedFormula (Fin k) n) :
    formulaCode (φ.imp ψ) = node 5 k n (ZFSet.pair (formulaCode φ) (formulaCode ψ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [formulaCode]

name: Forcing.formulaCode_all
statement:
@[simp] theorem formulaCode_all {k n : ℕ} (φ : memLang.BoundedFormula (Fin k) (n + 1)) :
    formulaCode φ.all = node 6 k n (formulaCode φ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [formulaCode]

name: Forcing.exists_node
statement:
theorem exists_node {k n : ℕ} (φ : memLang.BoundedFormula (Fin k) n) :
    ∃ tag p, formulaCode φ = node tag k n p
proof:
:= by
  match φ with
  | .falsum => exact ⟨2, ∅, by simp⟩
  | .equal t₁ t₂ => exact ⟨3, ZFSet.pair (termCode t₁) (termCode t₂), by simp⟩
  | .rel .mem ts => exact ⟨4, ZFSet.pair (termCode (ts 0)) (termCode (ts 1)), by simp⟩
  | .imp φ ψ => exact ⟨5, ZFSet.pair (formulaCode φ) (formulaCode ψ), by simp⟩
  | .all φ => exact ⟨6, formulaCode φ, by simp⟩

name: Forcing.arity_eq
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, p, hp⟩ := exists_node φ
  obtain ⟨t', p', hp'⟩ := exists_node ψ
  rw [hp, hp', node_inj] at h
  exact ⟨h.2.1, h.2.2.1⟩

name: Forcing.formulaCode_inj_of_arity
statement:
theorem formulaCode_inj_of_arity : ∀ {k n : ℕ} (φ ψ : memLang.BoundedFormula (Fin k) n),
    formulaCode φ = formulaCode ψ → φ = ψ
proof:
| _, _, .falsum, .falsum, _ => rfl
  | _, _, .equal t₁ t₂, .equal s₁ s₂, h => by
    simp only [formulaCode_equal, node_inj, ZFSet.pair_inj] at h
    rw [termCode_inj h.2.2.2.1, termCode_inj h.2.2.2.2]
  | _, _, .rel .mem ts, .rel .mem ss, h => by
    simp only [formulaCode_rel, node_inj, ZFSet.pair_inj] at h
    have h0 := termCode_inj h.2.2.2.1
    have h1 := termCode_inj h.2.2.2.2
    have hts : ts = ss := by
      funext i
      match i with
      | 0 => exact h0
      | 1 => exact h1
    rw [hts]
  | _, _, .imp φ ψ, .imp φ' ψ', h => by
    simp only [formulaCode_imp, node_inj, ZFSet.pair_inj] at h
    rw [formulaCode_inj_of_arity φ φ' h.2.2.2.1, formulaCode_inj_of_arity ψ ψ' h.2.2.2.2]
  | _, _, .all φ, .all φ', h => by
    simp only [formulaCode_all, node_inj] at h
    rw [formulaCode_inj_of_arity φ φ' h.2.2.2]
  | _, _, .falsum, .equal _ _, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .falsum, .rel .mem _, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .falsum, .imp _ _, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .falsum, .all _, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .equal _ _, .falsum, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .equal _ _, .rel .mem _, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .equal _ _, .imp _ _, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .equal _ _, .all _, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .rel .mem _, .falsum, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .rel .mem _, .equal _ _, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .rel .mem _, .imp _ _, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .rel .mem _, .all _, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .imp _ _, .falsum, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .imp _ _, .equal _ _, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .imp _ _, .rel .mem _, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .imp _ _, .all _, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .all _, .falsum, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .all _, .equal _ _, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .all _, .rel .mem _, h => by simp at h
  | _, _, .all _, .imp _ _, h => by simp at h

name: Forcing.formulaCode_inj
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := arity_eq h
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl, heq_of_eq (formulaCode_inj_of_arity φ ψ h)⟩

name: Forcing.isFormulaCode_formulaCode
statement:
theorem isFormulaCode_formulaCode : ∀ {k n : ℕ} (φ : memLang.BoundedFormula (Fin k) n),
    IsFormulaCode k n (formulaCode φ)
proof:
:= by
  intro k n φ
  induction φ with
  | falsum => simpa using IsFormulaCode.falsum _ _
  | equal t₁ t₂ => simpa using IsFormulaCode.equal t₁ t₂
  | rel R ts => cases R; simpa using IsFormulaCode.rel (ts 0) (ts 1)
  | imp _ _ ihφ ihψ => simpa using IsFormulaCode.imp ihφ ihψ
  | all _ ih => simpa using IsFormulaCode.all ih

name: Forcing.exists_formulaCode
statement:
theorem exists_formulaCode {k n : ℕ} {x : ZFSet.{u}} (h : IsFormulaCode k n x) :
    ∃ φ : memLang.BoundedFormula (Fin k) n, formulaCode φ = x
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | falsum _ => exact ⟨.falsum, by simp⟩
  | equal t₁ t₂ => exact ⟨.equal t₁ t₂, by simp⟩
  | rel t₁ t₂ => exact ⟨.rel memRel.mem ![t₁, t₂], by simp⟩
  | imp _ _ ihx ihy =>
    obtain ⟨φ, rfl⟩ := ihx
    obtain ⟨ψ, rfl⟩ := ihy
    exact ⟨φ.imp ψ, by simp⟩
  | all _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨φ, rfl⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨φ.all, by simp⟩

name: Forcing.PName.check_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem check_mk [Top P] (α : Type u) (A : α → PSet.{u}) :
    (check (.mk α A) : PName P) = mk α (fun a ↦ check (A a)) fun _ ↦ (⊤ : P)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Forcing.PName.val_check_equiv
statement:
theorem val_check_equiv [Top P] {S : Set P} (hS : (⊤ : P) ∈ S) (x : PSet.{u}) :
    PSet.Equiv ((check x : PName P).val S) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | mk α A IH =>
    exact ⟨fun i ↦ ⟨i.1, IH i.1⟩, fun a ↦ ⟨⟨a, hS⟩, IH a⟩⟩

name: Forcing.PName.zval_check
statement:
theorem zval_check [Top P] {S : Set P} (hS : (⊤ : P) ∈ S) (x : PSet.{u}) :
    zval S (check x) = ZFSet.mk x
proof:
:=
  ZFSet.sound (val_check_equiv hS x)

name: Forcing.PName.zval_check_pfilter
statement:
theorem zval_check_pfilter [Preorder P] [OrderTop P] (G : Order.PFilter P) (x : PSet.{u}) :
    zval (G : Set P) (check x) = ZFSet.mk x
proof:
:=
  zval_check G.top_mem x

name: Forcing.PName.zval_checkZF
statement:
theorem zval_checkZF [Top P] {S : Set P} (hS : (⊤ : P) ∈ S) (x : ZFSet.{u}) :
    zval S (checkZF x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [checkZF, zval_check hS, ZFSet.mk_out]

name: Forcing.PName.zval_checkZF_pfilter
statement:
theorem zval_checkZF_pfilter [Preorder P] [OrderTop P] (G : Order.PFilter P) (x : ZFSet.{u}) :
    zval (G : Set P) (checkZF x) = x
proof:
:=
  zval_checkZF G.top_mem x

name: Forcing.PName.val_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem val_mk (S : Set P) (ι : Type u) (e : ι → PName P) (c : ι → P) :
    (mk ι e c).val S = PSet.mk {i // c i ∈ S} fun i ↦ (e i.1).val S
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Forcing.PName.mem_zval_iff
statement:
theorem mem_zval_iff {S : Set P} {τ : PName P} {y : ZFSet.{u}} :
    y ∈ zval S τ ↔ ∃ i : τ.Idx, τ.conds i ∈ S ∧ y = zval S (τ.elems i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, e, c⟩ := τ
  induction y using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h z =>
    constructor
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, hz⟩ := h
      exact ⟨i, hi, ZFSet.sound hz⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, hy⟩
      exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, ZFSet.exact hy⟩

name: Forcing.PName.zval_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem zval_empty (S : Set P) : zval S (∅ : PName P) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  refine (ZFSet.eq_empty _).2 fun y hy ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨i, -, -⟩ := mem_zval_iff.1 hy
  exact PEmpty.elim i

name: Forcing.PName.exists_not_zval_subset_zval
statement:
theorem exists_not_zval_subset_zval :
    ∃ (τ : PName Bool) (S S' : Set Bool), S ⊆ S' ∧ ¬zval S τ ⊆ zval S' τ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mk PUnit (fun _ ↦ mk PUnit (fun _ ↦ ∅) fun _ ↦ true) fun _ ↦ false,
    {false}, Set.univ, Set.subset_univ _, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  have hin : zval ({false} : Set Bool)
      (mk PUnit (fun _ ↦ (∅ : PName Bool)) fun _ ↦ true) = ∅ := by
    refine (ZFSet.eq_empty _).2 fun y hy ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨i, hi, -⟩ := mem_zval_iff.1 hy
    simp at hi
  have hmem : (∅ : ZFSet) ∈ zval ({false} : Set Bool)
      (mk PUnit (fun _ ↦ mk PUnit (fun _ ↦ (∅ : PName Bool)) fun _ ↦ true) fun _ ↦ false) :=
    mem_zval_iff.2 ⟨PUnit.unit, rfl, hin.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨i, -, h0⟩ := mem_zval_iff.1 (h hmem)
  simp only [elems_mk] at h0
  have hne : (∅ : ZFSet) ∈ zval (Set.univ : Set Bool)
      (mk PUnit (fun _ ↦ (∅ : PName Bool)) fun _ ↦ true) :=
    mem_zval_iff.2 ⟨PUnit.unit, trivial, (zval_empty _).symm⟩
  rw [← h0] at hne
  exact ZFSet.notMem_empty _ hne

name: Forcing.forcesFormula_falsum
statement:
theorem forcesFormula_falsum {n} {xs : Fin n → PName P} :

proof:

name: Forcing.forcesFormula_equal
statement:
theorem forcesFormula_equal {n} {t₁ t₂ : memLang.Term (β ⊕ Fin n)} {xs : Fin n → PName P} :
    ForcesFormula 𝒩 v p (.equal t₁ t₂) xs ↔
      ForcesEq p (evalTerm (Sum.elim v xs) t₁) (evalTerm (Sum.elim v xs) t₂)
proof:

  Iff.rfl

name: Forcing.forcesFormula_rel
statement:
theorem forcesFormula_rel {n} {ts : Fin 2 → memLang.Term (β ⊕ Fin n)} {xs : Fin n → PName P} :
    ForcesFormula 𝒩 v p (.rel .mem ts) xs ↔
      ForcesMem p (evalTerm (Sum.elim v xs) (ts 0)) (evalTerm (Sum.elim v xs) (ts 1))
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Forcing.forcesFormula_imp
statement:
theorem forcesFormula_imp {n} {φ ψ : memLang.BoundedFormula β n} {xs : Fin n → PName P} :
    ForcesFormula 𝒩 v p (φ.imp ψ) xs ↔
      ∀ q ≤ p, ForcesFormula 𝒩 v q φ xs → ForcesFormula 𝒩 v q ψ xs
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Forcing.forcesFormula_all
statement:
theorem forcesFormula_all {n} {φ : memLang.BoundedFormula β (n + 1)} {xs : Fin n → PName P} :
    ForcesFormula 𝒩 v p φ.all xs ↔ ∀ τ ∈ 𝒩, ForcesFormula 𝒩 v p φ (Fin.snoc xs τ)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Forcing.ForcesFormula.mono
statement:
theorem ForcesFormula.mono :
    ∀ {n} {p q : P} (φ : memLang.BoundedFormula β n) {xs : Fin n → PName P},
      ForcesFormula 𝒩 v p φ xs → q ≤ p → ForcesFormula 𝒩 v q φ xs
proof:
| _, _, _, .falsum, _, h, _ => h
  | _, _, _, .equal _ _, _, h, hqp => ForcesEq.mono h hqp
  | _, _, _, .rel .mem _, _, h, hqp => ForcesMem.mono h hqp
  | _, _, _, .imp _ _, _, h, hqp => fun r hr hφ ↦ h r (hr.trans hqp) hφ
  | _, _, _, .all φ, _, h, hqp => fun τ hτ ↦ ForcesFormula.mono φ (h τ hτ) hqp

name: Forcing.forcesEq_of_isDenseBelow
statement:
theorem forcesEq_of_isDenseBelow (h : IsDenseBelow {q | ForcesEq q τ σ} p) :
    ForcesEq p τ σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [forcesEq_iff]
  constructor
  · intro i r hrp hrc
    have hD : IsDenseBelow {s | ForcesEq s τ σ ∧ s ≤ τ.conds i} r := fun s hs ↦ by
      obtain ⟨t, htEq, hts⟩ := h (Set.mem_Iic.2 ((Set.mem_Iic.1 hs).trans hrp))
      exact ⟨t, ⟨htEq, ((hts.trans (Set.mem_Iic.1 hs)).trans hrc)⟩, hts⟩
    exact hD.trans fun s hs ↦ (forcesEq_iff.1 hs.1).1 i s le_rfl hs.2
  · intro j r hrp hrc
    have hD : IsDenseBelow {s | ForcesEq s τ σ ∧ s ≤ σ.conds j} r := fun s hs ↦ by
      obtain ⟨t, htEq, hts⟩ := h (Set.mem_Iic.2 ((Set.mem_Iic.1 hs).trans hrp))
      exact ⟨t, ⟨htEq, ((hts.trans (Set.mem_Iic.1 hs)).trans hrc)⟩, hts⟩
    exact hD.trans fun s hs ↦ (forcesEq_iff.1 hs.1).2 j s le_rfl hs.2

name: Forcing.forcesMem_of_isDenseBelow
statement:
theorem forcesMem_of_isDenseBelow (h : IsDenseBelow {q | ForcesMem q τ σ} p) :
    ForcesMem p τ σ
proof:
:=
  IsDenseBelow.trans h fun _ hq ↦ hq

name: Forcing.forcesFormula_of_isDenseBelow
statement:
theorem forcesFormula_of_isDenseBelow :
    ∀ {n} (φ : memLang.BoundedFormula β n) {p : P} {xs : Fin n → PName P},
      IsDenseBelow {q | ForcesFormula 𝒩 v q φ xs} p → ForcesFormula 𝒩 v p φ xs
proof:
| _, .falsum, p, xs, h => by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := h (Set.mem_Iic.2 le_rfl)
    exact hy
  | _, .equal t₁ t₂, p, xs, h => forcesEq_of_isDenseBelow h
  | _, .rel .mem ts, p, xs, h => forcesMem_of_isDenseBelow h
  | _, .imp φ ψ, p, xs, h => fun r hrp hφ ↦
      forcesFormula_of_isDenseBelow ψ fun s hs ↦ by
        obtain ⟨t, htF, hts⟩ := h (Set.mem_Iic.2 (((Set.mem_Iic.1 hs).trans hrp)))
        exact ⟨t, htF t le_rfl (ForcesFormula.mono φ hφ (hts.trans (Set.mem_Iic.1 hs))), hts⟩
  | _, .all φ, p, xs, h => fun τ hτ ↦
      forcesFormula_of_isDenseBelow φ fun s hs ↦ by
        obtain ⟨t, htF, hts⟩ := h hs
        exact ⟨t, htF τ hτ, hts⟩

name: Forcing.forcesFormula_iff_isDenseBelow
statement:
theorem forcesFormula_iff_isDenseBelow {n} (φ : memLang.BoundedFormula β n)
    {xs : Fin n → PName P} :
    ForcesFormula 𝒩 v p φ xs ↔ IsDenseBelow {q | ForcesFormula 𝒩 v q φ xs} p
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ hr ↦ ⟨_, ForcesFormula.mono φ h (Set.mem_Iic.1 hr), le_rfl⟩,
    forcesFormula_of_isDenseBelow φ⟩

name: Forcing.ForcesSentence.mono

name: Forcing.forcesSentence_iff_isDenseBelow
statement:
theorem forcesSentence_iff_isDenseBelow (φ : memLang.Sentence) :
    p ⊩[𝒩] φ ↔ IsDenseBelow {q | q ⊩[𝒩] φ} p
proof:
:=
  forcesFormula_iff_isDenseBelow φ

name: Forcing.PName.mem_zval_genName_iff
statement:
theorem mem_zval_genName_iff [Top P] {S : Set P} (hS : (⊤ : P) ∈ S) {y : ZFSet.{u}} :
    y ∈ zval S (genName κ) ↔ ∃ p ∈ S, y = ZFSet.mk (κ.repr p)
proof:
:=
  mem_zval_iff.trans
    ⟨fun ⟨p, hp, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨p, hp, hy.trans (zval_check hS _)⟩,
      fun ⟨p, hp, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨p, hp, hy.trans (zval_check hS _).symm⟩⟩

name: Forcing.PName.eq_of_zval_genName_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_zval_genName_eq [Top P] {S T : Set P} (hS : (⊤ : P) ∈ S) (hT : (⊤ : P) ∈ T)
    (h : zval S (genName κ) = zval T (genName κ)) : S = T
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ {S T : Set P}, (⊤ : P) ∈ S → (⊤ : P) ∈ T →
      zval S (genName κ) = zval T (genName κ) → S ⊆ T := by
    intro S T hS hT h p hp
    have hmem : ZFSet.mk (κ.repr p) ∈ zval T (genName κ) := by
      rw [← h]
      exact (mem_zval_genName_iff hS).2 ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqe⟩ := (mem_zval_genName_iff hT).1 hmem
    rwa [κ.injective_mk hqe]
  exact Set.Subset.antisymm (key hS hT h) (key hT hS h.symm)

name: Forcing.PName.mem_zval_genName_iff_pfilter
statement:
theorem mem_zval_genName_iff_pfilter [Preorder P] [OrderTop P] (G : Order.PFilter P)
    {y : ZFSet.{u}} :
    y ∈ zval (G : Set P) (genName κ) ↔ ∃ p ∈ G, y = ZFSet.mk (κ.repr p)
proof:
:=
  mem_zval_genName_iff G.top_mem

name: Forcing.PName.eq_of_zval_genName_eq_pfilter
statement:
theorem eq_of_zval_genName_eq_pfilter [Preorder P] [OrderTop P] {G G' : Order.PFilter P}
    (h : zval (G : Set P) (genName κ) = zval (G' : Set P) (genName κ)) : G = G'
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  exact Set.ext_iff.1 (eq_of_zval_genName_eq G.top_mem G'.top_mem h) q

name: Forcing.incompatible_of_forces_of_forces_not
statement:
theorem incompatible_of_forces_of_forces_not (hp : ForcesFormula 𝒩 v p φ xs)
    (hq : ForcesFormula 𝒩 v q (∼φ) xs) : Incompatible p q
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨r, hrp, hrq⟩
  exact hq r hrq (ForcesFormula.mono φ hp hrp)

name: Forcing.HomogeneousFor.not_forcesFormula_not
statement:
theorem not_forcesFormula_not (h : HomogeneousFor 𝒩 v φ xs H)
    (hp : ForcesFormula 𝒩 v p φ xs) (q : P) : ¬ForcesFormula 𝒩 v q (∼φ) xs
proof:
:= by
  intro hq
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, hcompat⟩ := h.orbit_compatible p q (Or.inl hp) (Or.inr hq)
  exact incompatible_of_forces_of_forces_not (h.equivariant π hπ p hp) hq hcompat

name: Forcing.HomogeneousFor.forcesFormula_of_exists
statement:
theorem forcesFormula_of_exists (h : HomogeneousFor 𝒩 v φ xs H)
    (hdense : IsDense {r | Decides 𝒩 v r φ xs}) (hp : ForcesFormula 𝒩 v p φ xs) (q : P) :
    ForcesFormula 𝒩 v q φ xs
proof:
:= by
  refine forcesFormula_of_isDenseBelow φ fun r hr ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨s, hsD, hsr⟩ := hdense r
  rcases hsD with hs | hs
  · exact ⟨s, hs, hsr⟩
  · exact absurd hs (h.not_forcesFormula_not hp s)

  h.forcesFormula_of_exists hdense hp ⊤

name: Forcing.exists_blocker_of_not_forcesMem
statement:
theorem exists_blocker_of_not_forcesMem (h : ¬ForcesMem q τ σ) :
    ∃ r ≤ q, ∀ s ∈ memWitness τ σ, ¬s ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  exact h fun a ha ↦ hcon a ha

name: Forcing.isDenseOpen_eqDecision
statement: theorem isDenseOpen_eqDecision (τ σ : PName P) : IsDenseOpen (eqDecision τ σ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro p
    by_cases h : ForcesEq p τ σ
    · exact ⟨p, Or.inl (Or.inl h), le_rfl⟩
    · rw [forcesEq_iff, not_and_or] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · push Not at h
        obtain ⟨i, q, hqp, hqc, hq⟩ := h
        obtain ⟨r, hrq, hblock⟩ := exists_blocker_of_not_forcesMem hq
        refine ⟨r, Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨i, hrq.trans hqc, fun s hsr hFs ↦ ?_⟩), hrq.trans hqp⟩
        obtain ⟨y, hyW, hys⟩ := hFs (Set.mem_Iic.2 le_rfl)
        exact hblock y hyW (hys.trans hsr)
      · push Not at h
        obtain ⟨j, q, hqp, hqc, hq⟩ := h
        obtain ⟨r, hrq, hblock⟩ := exists_blocker_of_not_forcesMem hq
        refine ⟨r, Or.inr ⟨j, hrq.trans hqc, fun s hsr hFs ↦ ?_⟩, hrq.trans hqp⟩
        obtain ⟨y, hyW, hys⟩ := hFs (Set.mem_Iic.2 le_rfl)
        exact hblock y hyW (hys.trans hsr)
  · refine IsLowerSet.union (IsLowerSet.union ?_ ?_) ?_
    · exact fun a b hba ha ↦ ForcesEq.mono ha hba
    · rintro a b hba ⟨i, hac, hblock⟩
      exact ⟨i, hba.trans hac, fun s hsb ↦ hblock s (hsb.trans hba)⟩
    · rintro a b hba ⟨j, hac, hblock⟩
      exact ⟨j, hba.trans hac, fun s hsb ↦ hblock s (hsb.trans hba)⟩

name: Forcing.forces_adequacy
statement:
theorem forces_adequacy (h𝒩 : SubnameClosed 𝒩)
    (hmem : ∀ τ ∈ 𝒩, ∀ σ ∈ 𝒩, ∀ p ∈ G, ForcesMem p τ σ →
      Meets G (localizeBelow (memWitness τ σ) p))
    (heq : ∀ τ ∈ 𝒩, ∀ σ ∈ 𝒩, Meets G (eqDecision τ σ)) :
    ∀ τ σ : PName P, τ ∈ 𝒩 → σ ∈ 𝒩 →
      ((zval (G : Set P) τ ∈ zval (G : Set P) σ ↔ ∃ p ∈ G, ForcesMem p τ σ) ∧
        (zval (G : Set P) τ = zval (G : Set P) σ ↔ ∃ p ∈ G, ForcesEq p τ σ))
proof:
:= by
  refine Sym2.GameAdd.recursion subname_wellFounded fun τ σ IH hτ hσ ↦ ?_
  have memAdeq :
      zval (G : Set P) τ ∈ zval (G : Set P) σ ↔ ∃ p ∈ G, ForcesMem p τ σ := by
    constructor
    · intro hy
      rw [mem_zval_iff] at hy
      obtain ⟨i, hci, hval⟩ := hy
      obtain ⟨q, hqG, hqEq⟩ :=
        ((IH τ (σ.elems i) (Sym2.GameAdd.snd (subname_elems σ i)) hτ (h𝒩 σ hσ i)).2).1 hval
      obtain ⟨r, hrG, hrq, hrc⟩ := exists_mem_le_le hqG hci
      refine ⟨r, hrG, fun a ha ↦ ?_⟩
      exact ⟨a, mem_memWitness_iff.2
        ⟨i, (Set.mem_Iic.1 ha).trans hrc, hqEq.mono ((Set.mem_Iic.1 ha).trans hrq)⟩, le_rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨p, hpG, hpF⟩
      obtain ⟨w, hwG, hwW⟩ := (meets_localizeBelow_iff hpG).1 (hmem τ hτ σ hσ p hpG hpF)
      obtain ⟨i, hwc, hwEq⟩ := mem_memWitness_iff.1 hwW
      rw [mem_zval_iff]
      exact ⟨i, G.mem_of_le hwc hwG,
        ((IH τ (σ.elems i) (Sym2.GameAdd.snd (subname_elems σ i)) hτ (h𝒩 σ hσ i)).2).2
          ⟨w, hwG, hwEq⟩⟩
  have eqAdeq :
      zval (G : Set P) τ = zval (G : Set P) σ ↔ ∃ p ∈ G, ForcesEq p τ σ := by
    constructor
    · intro hval
      obtain ⟨p, hpG, hp⟩ := heq τ hτ σ hσ
      rcases hp with (hp | hp) | hp
      · exact ⟨p, hpG, hp⟩
      · exfalso
        obtain ⟨i, hpc, hblock⟩ := hp
        have hmemi : zval (G : Set P) (τ.elems i) ∈ zval (G : Set P) σ := by
          rw [← hval, mem_zval_iff]
          exact ⟨i, G.mem_of_le hpc hpG, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨q, hqG, hqF⟩ :=
          ((IH (τ.elems i) σ (Sym2.GameAdd.fst (subname_elems τ i)) (h𝒩 τ hτ i) hσ).1).1 hmemi
        obtain ⟨r, hrG, hrp, hrq⟩ := exists_mem_le_le hpG hqG
        exact hblock r hrp (hqF.mono hrq)
      · exfalso
        obtain ⟨j, hpc, hblock⟩ := hp
        have hmemj : zval (G : Set P) (σ.elems j) ∈ zval (G : Set P) τ := by
          rw [hval, mem_zval_iff]
          exact ⟨j, G.mem_of_le hpc hpG, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨q, hqG, hqF⟩ :=
          ((IH (σ.elems j) τ (Sym2.GameAdd.fst_snd (subname_elems σ j)) (h𝒩 σ hσ j) hτ).1).1
            hmemj
        obtain ⟨r, hrG, hrp, hrq⟩ := exists_mem_le_le hpG hqG
        exact hblock r hrp (hqF.mono hrq)
    · rintro ⟨p, hpG, hpEq⟩
      rw [forcesEq_iff] at hpEq
      refine ZFSet.ext fun y ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro hy
        rw [mem_zval_iff] at hy
        obtain ⟨i, hci, rfl⟩ := hy
        obtain ⟨r, hrG, hrp, hrc⟩ := exists_mem_le_le hpG hci
        exact ((IH (τ.elems i) σ (Sym2.GameAdd.fst (subname_elems τ i)) (h𝒩 τ hτ i) hσ).1).2
          ⟨r, hrG, hpEq.1 i r hrp hrc⟩
      · intro hy
        rw [mem_zval_iff] at hy
        obtain ⟨j, hcj, rfl⟩ := hy
        obtain ⟨r, hrG, hrp, hrc⟩ := exists_mem_le_le hpG hcj
        exact ((IH (σ.elems j) τ (Sym2.GameAdd.fst_snd (subname_elems σ j)) (h𝒩 σ hσ j) hτ).1).2
          ⟨r, hrG, hpEq.2 j r hrp hrc⟩
  exact ⟨memAdeq, eqAdeq⟩

name: Forcing.zval_mem_zval_iff_exists_forcesMem
statement:
theorem zval_mem_zval_iff_exists_forcesMem (h𝒩 : SubnameClosed 𝒩)
    (hmem : ∀ τ ∈ 𝒩, ∀ σ ∈ 𝒩, ∀ p ∈ G, ForcesMem p τ σ →
      Meets G (localizeBelow (memWitness τ σ) p))
    (heq : ∀ τ ∈ 𝒩, ∀ σ ∈ 𝒩, Meets G (eqDecision τ σ))
    (hτ : τ ∈ 𝒩) (hσ : σ ∈ 𝒩) :
    zval (G : Set P) τ ∈ zval (G : Set P) σ ↔ ∃ p ∈ G, ForcesMem p τ σ
proof:
:=
  (forces_adequacy h𝒩 hmem heq τ σ hτ hσ).1

name: Forcing.zval_eq_zval_iff_exists_forcesEq
statement:
theorem zval_eq_zval_iff_exists_forcesEq (h𝒩 : SubnameClosed 𝒩)
    (hmem : ∀ τ ∈ 𝒩, ∀ σ ∈ 𝒩, ∀ p ∈ G, ForcesMem p τ σ →
      Meets G (localizeBelow (memWitness τ σ) p))
    (heq : ∀ τ ∈ 𝒩, ∀ σ ∈ 𝒩, Meets G (eqDecision τ σ))
    (hτ : τ ∈ 𝒩) (hσ : σ ∈ 𝒩) :
    zval (G : Set P) τ = zval (G : Set P) σ ↔ ∃ p ∈ G, ForcesEq p τ σ
proof:
:=
  (forces_adequacy h𝒩 hmem heq τ σ hτ hσ).2

name: Forcing.forces_adequacy_of_genericOver
statement:
theorem forces_adequacy_of_genericOver {M : VisibilityContext P} (hG : GenericOver M G)
    (h𝒩 : SubnameClosed 𝒩)
    (hvmem : ∀ τ ∈ 𝒩, ∀ σ ∈ 𝒩, ∀ p ∈ G, ForcesMem p τ σ →
      M.Visible (localizeBelow (memWitness τ σ) p))
    (hveq : ∀ τ ∈ 𝒩, ∀ σ ∈ 𝒩, M.Visible (eqDecision τ σ)) :
    ∀ τ σ : PName P, τ ∈ 𝒩 → σ ∈ 𝒩 →
      ((zval (G : Set P) τ ∈ zval (G : Set P) σ ↔ ∃ p ∈ G, ForcesMem p τ σ) ∧
        (zval (G : Set P) τ = zval (G : Set P) σ ↔ ∃ p ∈ G, ForcesEq p τ σ))
proof:
:=
  forces_adequacy h𝒩
    (fun τ hτ σ hσ p hpG hF ↦
      hG _ ⟨hvmem τ hτ σ hσ p hpG hF, isDenseOpen_localizeBelow hF⟩)
    (fun τ hτ σ hσ ↦ hG _ ⟨hveq τ hτ σ hσ, isDenseOpen_eqDecision τ σ⟩)

name: Forcing.exists_blocker_of_not_forcesFormula
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  refine h (forcesFormula_of_isDenseBelow φ fun s hs ↦ ?_)
  obtain ⟨t, hts, htF⟩ := hcon s (Set.mem_Iic.1 hs)
  exact ⟨t, htF, hts⟩

name: Forcing.isDenseOpen_impDecision
statement:
theorem isDenseOpen_impDecision {n} (φ ψ : memLang.BoundedFormula β n)
    (xs : Fin n → PName P) : IsDenseOpen (impDecision 𝒩 v φ ψ xs)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro r
    by_cases h : ForcesFormula 𝒩 v r (φ.imp ψ) xs
    · exact ⟨r, Or.inl h, le_rfl⟩
    · rw [forcesFormula_imp] at h
      push Not at h
      obtain ⟨q, hqr, hqφ, hqψ⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨s, hsq, hblock⟩ := exists_blocker_of_not_forcesFormula hqψ
      exact ⟨s, Or.inr ⟨ForcesFormula.mono φ hqφ hsq, hblock⟩, hsq.trans hqr⟩
  · refine IsLowerSet.union (fun a b hba h ↦ ForcesFormula.mono _ h hba) ?_
    rintro a b hba ⟨hφ, hblock⟩
    exact ⟨ForcesFormula.mono φ hφ hba, fun t htb ↦ hblock t (htb.trans hba)⟩

name: Forcing.isDenseOpen_allDecision
statement:
theorem isDenseOpen_allDecision {n} (φ : memLang.BoundedFormula β (n + 1))
    (xs : Fin n → PName P) : IsDenseOpen (allDecision 𝒩 v φ xs)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro r
    by_cases h : ForcesFormula 𝒩 v r φ.all xs
    · exact ⟨r, Or.inl h, le_rfl⟩
    · rw [forcesFormula_all] at h
      push Not at h
      obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hτF⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨s, hsr, hblock⟩ := exists_blocker_of_not_forcesFormula hτF
      exact ⟨s, Or.inr ⟨τ, hτ, hblock⟩, hsr⟩
  · refine IsLowerSet.union (fun a b hba h ↦ ForcesFormula.mono _ h hba) ?_
    rintro a b hba ⟨τ, hτ, hblock⟩
    exact ⟨τ, hτ, fun t htb ↦ hblock t (htb.trans hba)⟩

name: Forcing.isDenseOpen_of_mem_formulaTests
statement:
theorem isDenseOpen_of_mem_formulaTests :
    ∀ {n} (φ : memLang.BoundedFormula β n) (xs : Fin n → PName P),
      ∀ D ∈ formulaTests 𝒩 v φ xs, IsDenseOpen D
proof:
| _, .falsum, _, _, hD => absurd hD (Set.notMem_empty _)
  | _, .equal _ _, _, _, hD => absurd hD (Set.notMem_empty _)
  | _, .rel _ _, _, _, hD => absurd hD (Set.notMem_empty _)
  | _, .imp φ ψ, xs, D, hD => by
    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.1 hD with rfl | hD
    · exact isDenseOpen_impDecision φ ψ xs
    · rcases hD with hD | hD
      · exact isDenseOpen_of_mem_formulaTests φ xs D hD
      · exact isDenseOpen_of_mem_formulaTests ψ xs D hD
  | _, .all φ, xs, D, hD => by
    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.1 hD with rfl | hD
    · exact isDenseOpen_allDecision φ xs
    · obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hD⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hD
      exact isDenseOpen_of_mem_formulaTests φ (Fin.snoc xs τ) D hD

name: Forcing.mem_memWitness_iff
statement:
theorem mem_memWitness_iff {q : P} :
    q ∈ memWitness τ σ ↔ ∃ i : σ.Idx, q ≤ σ.conds i ∧ ForcesEq q τ (σ.elems i)
proof:
:= by
  change MemWitness q τ σ ↔ _
  rw [MemWitness]

name: Forcing.forcesMem_iff
statement:
theorem forcesMem_iff :
    ForcesMem p τ σ ↔
      IsDenseBelow {q | ∃ i : σ.Idx, q ≤ σ.conds i ∧ ForcesEq q τ (σ.elems i)} p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ForcesMem, memWitness, MemWitness]

name: Forcing.forcesEq_iff
statement:
theorem forcesEq_iff :
    ForcesEq p τ σ ↔
      (∀ i : τ.Idx, ∀ q ≤ p, q ≤ τ.conds i → ForcesMem q (τ.elems i) σ) ∧
        (∀ j : σ.Idx, ∀ q ≤ p, q ≤ σ.conds j → ForcesMem q (σ.elems j) τ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ForcesEq]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: Forcing.ForcesMem.mono
statement: theorem ForcesMem.mono (h : ForcesMem p τ σ) (hqp : q ≤ p) : ForcesMem q τ σ
proof:
:=
  IsDenseBelow.mono_condition h hqp

name: Forcing.ForcesEq.mono
statement: theorem ForcesEq.mono (h : ForcesEq p τ σ) (hqp : q ≤ p) : ForcesEq q τ σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [forcesEq_iff] at h ⊢
  exact ⟨fun i r hrq hri ↦ h.1 i r (hrq.trans hqp) hri,
    fun j r hrq hrj ↦ h.2 j r (hrq.trans hqp) hrj⟩

name: Forcing.ForcesEq.symm
statement: theorem ForcesEq.symm (h : ForcesEq p τ σ) : ForcesEq p σ τ
proof:
:= by
  rw [forcesEq_iff] at h ⊢
  exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩

name: Forcing.forcesEq_comm
statement: theorem forcesEq_comm : ForcesEq p τ σ ↔ ForcesEq p σ τ
proof:
:=
  ⟨.symm, .symm⟩

name: Forcing.forcesEq_refl
statement: theorem forcesEq_refl : ∀ (τ : PName P) (p : P), ForcesEq p τ τ
proof:
:= by
  intro τ
  induction τ with
  | mk ι e c ih =>
    intro p
    rw [forcesEq_iff]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    · intro i q _ hqi
      rw [forcesMem_iff]
      intro r hr
      exact ⟨r, ⟨i, (Set.mem_Iic.1 hr).trans hqi, ih i r⟩, le_rfl⟩

name: Forcing.forcesDef_imp

    forcesDef rec (φ.imp ψ) Γ p a =
      ∀' ((memFormula (&(Fin.last m)) Γ.lift.condSet ⊓

name: Forcing.forcesDef_all

      ∀' (rec.relabel Γ.recParams ⟹
        ∀' (pairDef (&(Fin.castSucc (Fin.last m))) (liftTerm (liftTerm a))

          forcesDef rec φ Γ.lift.lift (liftTerm (liftTerm p)) (&(Fin.last (m + 1)))))

name: Forcing.realize_relabel_snoc
statement:
theorem realize_relabel_snoc (rec : memLang.BoundedFormula (Fin arity) 1)
    (g : Fin arity → α ⊕ Fin m) (c : M) :
    (rec.relabel g).Realize v (Fin.snoc xs c) ↔
      rec.Realize (fun i ↦ Sum.elim v xs (g i)) ![c]
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (Sum.elim v (Fin.snoc xs c ∘ Fin.castAdd 1) ∘ g) = fun i ↦ Sum.elim v xs (g i) := by
    funext i
    cases h : g i with
    | inl _ => simp [h]
    | inr j =>
      simp only [h, Sum.elim_inr, Function.comp_apply]
      have hc : (Fin.castAdd 1 j : Fin (m + 1)) = Fin.castSucc j := by ext; simp
      rw [hc, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  have h2 : (Fin.snoc xs c ∘ Fin.natAdd m) = ![c] := by
    funext i
    have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst hi
    have hn : Fin.natAdd m (0 : Fin 1) = Fin.last m := by ext; simp
    simp [hn]
  rw [BoundedFormula.realize_relabel, h1, h2]

name: Forcing.realize_forcesDef_imp
statement:
theorem realize_forcesDef_imp {φ ψ : memLang.BoundedFormula (Fin k) sn} :
    (forcesDef rec (φ.imp ψ) Γ p a).Realize v xs ↔
      ∀ q : ↥M, ((q : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∈
            ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) Γ.condSet : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) →
        ZFSet.pair ((q : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u})
            ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) p : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∈
          ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) Γ.orderCode : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) →
        ((forcesDef rec φ Γ.lift (&(Fin.last m)) (liftTerm a)).Realize v (Fin.snoc xs q) →
          (forcesDef rec ψ Γ.lift (&(Fin.last m)) (liftTerm a)).Realize v (Fin.snoc xs q))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [forcesDef_imp, BoundedFormula.realize_all, BoundedFormula.realize_imp,
    BoundedFormula.realize_inf, memFormula, BoundedFormula.realize_rel₂, relMap_mem,
    realize_pairMemDef, CompilerParams.lift, Term.realize_var, Sum.elim_inr,
    Function.comp_apply, Fin.snoc_last, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    realize_liftTerm, and_imp]

name: Forcing.realize_forcesDef_all
statement:
theorem realize_forcesDef_all {φ : memLang.BoundedFormula (Fin k) (sn + 1)} :
    (forcesDef rec φ.all Γ p a).Realize v xs ↔
      ∀ c : ↥M, rec.Realize (fun i ↦ Sum.elim v xs (Γ.recParams i)) ![c] →
        ∀ a' : ↥M, ((a' : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) = ZFSet.pair ((c : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u})
              ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) a : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) →
          (forcesDef rec φ Γ.lift.lift (liftTerm (liftTerm p))
            (&(Fin.last (m + 1)))).Realize v (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc xs c) a')
proof:
:= by
  simp only [forcesDef_all, BoundedFormula.realize_all, BoundedFormula.realize_imp,
    realize_pairDef, Term.realize_var, Sum.elim_inr, Function.comp_apply, Fin.snoc_last,
    Fin.snoc_castSucc, realize_liftTerm]
  exact forall_congr' fun c ↦ imp_congr_left (realize_relabel_snoc rec Γ.recParams c)

name: Forcing.realize_forcesDef_equal
statement:
theorem realize_forcesDef_equal {t₁ t₂ : memLang.Term (Fin k ⊕ Fin sn)}
    (hm : ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) Γ.tagMem : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) = natCode memWitnessTag)
    (hq : ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) Γ.tagEq : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) = natCode eqTag) :
    (forcesDef rec (.equal t₁ t₂) Γ p a).Realize v xs ↔
      ∃ x y : ↥M,
        LookupAt (srcPeel t₁) ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) a : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u})
            ((x : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∧
        LookupAt (srcPeel t₂) ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) a : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u})
            ((y : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∧
        ∃ A : ↥M, ((A : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}).IsTransitive ∧
          ((x : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∈ ((A : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∧
          ((y : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∈ ((A : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∧
          ∃ R : ↥M, AtomicCoherentOn ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) Γ.condSet : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u})
              ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) Γ.orderCode : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u})
              ((A : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ((R : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∧
            entry eqTag ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) p : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u})
              ((x : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ((y : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∈ ((R : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u})
proof:
:= by
  have hatom : ∀ x y : ↥M,
      (forcesEqDef Γ.lift.lift.tagMem Γ.lift.lift.tagEq Γ.lift.lift.condSet
        Γ.lift.lift.orderCode (liftTerm (liftTerm p))
        (&(Fin.castSucc (Fin.last m))) (&(Fin.last (m + 1)))).Realize v
          (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc xs x) y) ↔
        ∃ A : ↥M, ((A : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}).IsTransitive ∧
          ((x : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∈ ((A : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∧
          ((y : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∈ ((A : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∧
          ∃ R : ↥M, AtomicCoherentOn ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) Γ.condSet : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u})
              ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) Γ.orderCode : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u})
              ((A : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ((R : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∧
            entry eqTag ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) p : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u})
              ((x : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ((y : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∈ ((R : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) := by
    intro x y
    rw [realize_forcesEqDef (by simpa [CompilerParams.lift, realize_liftTerm] using hm)
      (by simpa [CompilerParams.lift, realize_liftTerm] using hq)]
    simp [CompilerParams.lift, realize_liftTerm]
  simp only [forcesDef_equal, BoundedFormula.realize_ex, BoundedFormula.realize_inf,
    realize_lookupDef, Term.realize_var, Sum.elim_inr, Function.comp_apply, Fin.snoc_last,
    Fin.snoc_castSucc, realize_liftTerm]
  exact exists_congr fun x ↦ exists_congr fun y ↦
    and_congr_right fun _ ↦ and_congr_right fun _ ↦ hatom x y

name: Forcing.realize_forcesDef_rel
statement:
theorem realize_forcesDef_rel {ts : Fin 2 → memLang.Term (Fin k ⊕ Fin sn)}
    (hm : ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) Γ.tagMem : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) = natCode memWitnessTag)
    (hq : ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) Γ.tagEq : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) = natCode eqTag) :
    (forcesDef rec (.rel .mem ts) Γ p a).Realize v xs ↔

            ((y : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∧
        ∃ A : ↥M, ((A : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}).IsTransitive ∧

              ((x : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ((y : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u})
proof:
:= by
  have hatom : ∀ x y : ↥M,
      (forcesMemDef Γ.lift.lift.tagMem Γ.lift.lift.tagEq Γ.lift.lift.condSet
        Γ.lift.lift.orderCode (liftTerm (liftTerm p))
        (&(Fin.castSucc (Fin.last m))) (&(Fin.last (m + 1)))).Realize v
          (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc xs x) y) ↔
        ∃ A : ↥M, ((A : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}).IsTransitive ∧
          ((x : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∈ ((A : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∧
          ((y : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∈ ((A : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u}) ∧
          ∃ R : ↥M, AtomicCoherentOn ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) Γ.condSet : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u})
              ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) Γ.orderCode : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u})

            DenseMem ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) Γ.condSet : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u})
              ((Term.realize (Sum.elim v xs) Γ.orderCode : ↥M) : ZFSet.{u})
